Alloggio Agrituristico "All'Antica Scuderia del Castello"
Welcome to a place where history, charm, and authentic Italian hospitality come together in a unique and unforgettable setting.
ALL'ANTICA SCUDERIA DEL CASTELLO
25 years of experience and passion
Nestled in the heart of the Friulian hills, where gentle slopes meet meadows and woodlands, Agriturismo All'Antica Scuderia del Castello was founded in 2001 as a place of peace, nature and authentic hospitality.
Housed in a charming two-storey building dating back to the 1700s ,once the stable of the castle of Susans, the agriturismo has been carefully restored and furnished with original antique furniture and traditional tools, preserving its historic soul.
We offer bed and breakfast accommodation in a warm and welcoming environment, ideal for guests seeking tranquillity, silence and a close connection with nature.
"All rooms are spacious and equipped with private bathroom, air conditioning and free Wi-Fi."
DISCOVER MORE
ALLOGGIO AGRITURISTICO
ROOMS
Our rooms — Liberty,
Ciliegio, Mirto and Maggiociondolo
— are furnished with handcrafted antique pieces, each with its
own unique character.
The
Liberty
room, located on the ground floor, is a spacious family suite and has
been designed with accessibility
features for guests
with reduced mobility.
DISCOVER MORE
OUR FARM
Family run since 1940, respecting nature and local traditions
LEARNING FARM
We are passionate about what we do and we like to share this passion with our guests.
By staying in our farm you will have the opportunity to experience the beauty of nature and learn how we cultivate our olive trees and transform olives into EVO O extra virgin olive oil.
Through hands-on experiences, it encourages everyone to live a healthy , sustainable and good life, closely connected to the Mediterranean countryside.
"Gli alberi raccontano" Learning Farm
The activities offered by the learning farm " Gli alberi raccontano " are suitable for everyone The philosophy is to bring people closer to the world of extra virgin olive oil , to learn about the qualities and flaws of this product and make informed purchases.
From harvesting in the field, to the production process, or simply an organoleptic journey with sensory workshops .
DISCOVER MORE
Farm to Table
EXTRA VIRGIN OLIVE OIL
100% NATURAL
On the gentle slopes of Susans, we cultivate over 350 olive trees. Since 1997, we selected and planted renowned, high-quality cultivars: Frantoio, Leccino, Pendolino and Bianchera, a local variety of Friuli Venezia Giulia that thrives in this unique territory.
The average production is about 300 liters of olive oil per year, a deliberately limited quantity that allows meticulous control at every stage and guarantees consistently superior, authentic quality.
DISCOVER MORE
NEWS
Discover what's new!
Coming this year - the pool!
05/03/2025
There are places where time doesn't disappear—it simply softens. This year, our story gains a new chapter with the arrival of a swimming pool and sun terrace, thoughtfully created to offer moments of quiet pleasure and deep relaxation.
New Label - Olio del Vichingo
12/12/2024
We are delighted to share a piece of news that is especially close to our hearts: our extra virgin olive oil now has a new label and a new name:
Olio del Vichingo .
The Secrets of Extra Virgin Olive Oil
01/11/2024
We are honored to have been invited to share our experience as olive growers at the conference "L'Olio Nuovo dal Cuore del FVG" , taking place on November 25, 2023, at 10:00 a.m. at the Mercato Coperto di Campagna Amica in Udine.
TESTIMONIALS

Mariella e Maurizio
Verona

Die komfortablen Zimmer sind groß und geschmackvoll mit Stilmöbeln eingerichtet. Sehr nette und hilfreiche Inhaberin, die ein leckeres und familiäres Frühstück anbietet. La camera con bagno davvero ampia e comoda. Ottima la prima colazione, eccellente l'olio di loro produzione. La proprietaria Barbara gentile e disponibile ci ha dato ottime indicazione su cosa visitare. Ci torneremo di sicuro.
Maristella
Italia

Rooms :: Alloggio Agrituristico "All'Antica Scuderia del Castello"
ROOMS
Our rooms — LIBERTY,
CILIEGIO, MIRTO and MAGGIOCIONDOLO
— are furnished with handcrafted antique pieces, each with its
own unique character.
The
Liberty
room, located on the ground floor, is a spacious family suite and has
been designed with accessibility
features for guests
with reduced mobility.
We serve a traditional Italian
breakfast with
freshly baked bread, croissants and seasonal fruit.
On request
and at an additional cost, guests may enjoy a savory
breakfast featuring
local specialties such as San
Daniele cured ham, salami and cheeses,
all sourced from local producers.
LIBERTY
Ground floor | Elegant | Family suite
Capacity:
up to 5 guests
A spacious room on the ground floor,
furnished with authentic wooden and wrought-iron pieces from the
1800s .
Designed
for families, it is fully air-conditioned and suitable for guests
with limited mobility.
The private bathroom is easily accessible
directly from the bedroom.
Check availability
CILIEGIO
Top floor | Panoramic
Capacity:
2 guests
Bright and spacious double room
located on the top floor.
The floor features beautiful original
tiles from the 1800s ,
while the cherry-wood furniture dates back to the early 1900s .
The room
is air-conditioned, well lit and offers panoramic views: south-facing
over the garden and west-facing towards the village of
Susans.
Private bathroom with direct access from the room.
Check availability
MAGGIOCIONDOLO
First floor | Romantic
Capacity: 2 guests
A charming room for two guests,
furnished with two
original Friulian wrought-iron single beds from the 1800s ,
which can be arranged as twin beds or a double bed.
The
remaining furnishings are made of wood, creating a warm and authentic
atmosphere.
The room
is air-conditioned and overlooks the south-facing garden.
Private
bathroom with direct access.
Check availability
MIRTO
First floor | Single room
Capacity: 2 guests
The Mirto room is located on the
first floor and can be connected
to the Ciliegio or Maggiociondolo rooms ,
making it ideal for families.
It
features a single bed made of authentic cherry wood from the early
1900s ,
with the possibility of an additional extra bed.
The window
faces south, offering a pleasant view of the garden.
Check availability

About us :: Alloggio Agrituristico "All'Antica Scuderia del Castello"
ALL'ANTICA SCUDERIA DEL CASTELLO
We offer bed
and breakfast accommodation in four rooms ,
all furnished with antique furniture.
The agriturismo is
located in the main house, dating back to the 1700s ,
and has been tastefully restored to preserve its historic character.
Vintage
furnishings and natural materials create a warm,
cosy and intimate atmosphere ,
ideal for a relaxing stay.
We can accommodate up
to 11 guests in:
two
double rooms
one
single room
one
family suite with four beds
With
the exception of the single room ( Mirto ),
all rooms feature a private
bathroom, air conditioning and complimentary Wi-Fi .
CHECK AVAILABILITY
OUR STORY
Our story begins in 1883 ,
with the birth of Antonio
"da la Mia" Zuliani ,
known as Vigilant ,
in Forgaria, a small Friulian village nestled among the mountains.
At
just eight years old, Antonio left home to work as a kitchen
assistant in Romania. After a life rich in adventure and hard work,
in 1940
he and his brother Pietro
purchased the Castle
of Susans and the
entire estate from Count Rodolfo IV, Count of Susans and Marquis of
S. Sofia and Recanati.
The
property included not only the castle and its annexes, but also 174
hectares of fields and woodlands .
The estate was divided between the two brothers: Pietro retained
ownership of the castle and part of the land, while Antonio acquired
the farmsteads, their surrounding lands, the former stables—where
he later built his home—and the woodlands.
Over
the years, and especially following the 1976
earthquake , the
buildings underwent several structural and architectural changes,
shaped by both necessity and evolving agricultural needs.
After
Antonio's passing in 1969 ,
the farm was taken over by his daughter Maria
Luisa and her
husband Valter
Giacomuzzi . In
2001 ,
they transformed the family farm into an agriturismo, opening its
doors to guests.
Since
2003 ,
Barbara
has been involved in the management of the agriturismo, and in 2007
she officially took over, together with her husband David ,
who lovingly cares for the olive grove and the olive oil mill.
